Seat of Fire, Light Well 4-5, Wang Cheong House 2467

burnt remnant of cigarette end

Laboratory Examination Results:  
Nothing of significance was found with respect to recovery of ignitable liquid residues from all debris samples seized from the seat of fire

View of seat of fire from the metal gate  
Item 25C2835/10 (WC5) was found comprised mainly burnt remnants of carton papers of the mosaic tiles boxes with a few pieces of backing papers. A piece of plastic board remnant fused with carton papers, burnt remnant of suspected orange toe-board and a burnt remnant of cigarette end were also found mingled with these carton papers.
